fact: CSquared with Phase3 and SBIN announced a new terrestrial fibre route from Lagos to Accra through Ghana, Togo and Benin, configured, activated and tested, with the ready-for-service date not yet announced.
CSquared's CEO says it connected its cross-border circuits from Togo into Ghana and Benin and provided capacity to MTN Ghana and Vodafone Ghana through the Equiano landing station in Lome.
